text:
maria: heads-up — quick copy review needed for the credential-rotation banner in the workspace settings. current text: "Rotate API key — this will invalidate existing keys immediately." thinking we need softer language + clear next steps for less technical users.
alex: Agreed. The current wording feels abrupt. Maybe: "Rotate API key (recommended). New key will replace the existing key. Update any services using the old key." shorter CTA: `Rotate key` or `Create & rotate`?
jordan: I like the milder lead. Suggest splitting into a 2-line banner: Title + helper line. Title = "Rotate API key". Helper = "Create a replacement key now — services using the old key will need the new value." ben: Question: do we invalidate old key immediately on rotate? our backend can support a grace period, but product decided immediate invalidation for safety. If immediate, we must say that clearly, but avoid scaring non-technical users.
sam: UX nit: call-to-action label should convey outcome, not action. `Create replacement key` vs `Rotate key`. People don't always know what rotate means.
alex: Good point. Maybe CTA: `Create replacement` and secondary text: "The old key will stop working immediately after you confirm." Also add link to docs: "Learn more about rotating keys" (opens in new tab).
maria: Accessibility: add aria-live="polite" for the banner so screen readers announce it, and ensure focus is not stolen when it appears. Also confirm color contrast for the helper text meets AA.
jordan: Tone options I sketched:
- Conservative: "Rotate API key (recommended). Create a replacement key and update services. The old key will be revoked immediately."
- Simple: "Create replacement key. The old key will stop working after rotation."
- Explicit stepper: "Step 1: Create replacement. Step 2: Update services. Step 3: Revoke old key." (might be too long for banner)
ben: For error state when the rotation fails, copy should surface recovery steps: "Rotation failed. Try again or contact support with error ID: `{{error_id}}`." keep it short.
sam: Small localization note: avoid idioms like "stop working" -> prefer "will no longer work" for clearer translations.
alex: CTA variants for testing: ["Create replacement", "Rotate key", "Generate new key"]. We can A/B a more technical vs. more descriptive label.
maria: Also propose inline microcopy under the CTA for people who want automation: "Use the API to rotate keys: `POST /orgs/:id/keys/rotate`" (link to docs).user-testing ask: ask support agents whether they need a confirm modal with a typed acknowledgment for high-risk orgs.
designbot: Reminder: asset `settings/keys/rotate-modal` exists in Figma. Update copy there as well.
jordan: Accessibility addendum: ensure the confirmation modal has role="dialog" and descriptive aria-labelledby pointing to title text. For the input field placeholder avoid implying scanned values: use "Enter new key name (optional)".
ben: I'm fine with the Simple tone + "Create replacement key" CTA. Also suggest adding inline help icon next to helper text for advanced options (grace period info).
sam: +1 to the help icon. For translations, keep sentences under 120 chars.
maria: ok next steps: alex, can you draft final banner copy with 2 CTA variants and the error stub? put in Figma and ping me. I'll update the release note. alex: yep, I'll post file updates in this thread in ~30 mins. :thumbsup:
alex: posted Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/settings-keys-rotate — copy variants are in frame "rotate-banner-copy-v2". ping me with anything else.
maria: LGTM for content direction. Thanks everyone. We’ll run a quick microcopy test with support next week.
